build_script:
@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0.."
call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
set "CUDA_PATH=%CD%\build-local\cuda-13.0"
set "PATH=%CUDA_PATH%\bin;%CUDA_PATH%\bin\x64;%PATH%"
cmake -S backends/glm5next -B build-local/glm5next-candidate-cuda -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release "-DSTRATA_GLM_ARCHIVE=%CD%/build-local/llama-glm-86ebfef2.tar.gz" -DSTRATA_GLM_ARCHIVE_SHA256=f8e524b635b726bae74fd8f84bb9249e5b09384c63207f6707c5a3f921acad99 -DSTRATA_GLM_CUDA=ON -DSTRATA_GLM_GRAPH_CHECK=ON -DSTRATA_GLM_SYNC_BASELINE=ON "-DPython3_EXECUTABLE=C:/Users/Aleks/AppData/Local/Programs/Python/Python312/python.exe" -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=120 "-DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER=%CUDA_PATH%/bin/nvcc.exe" "-DCUDAToolkit_ROOT=%CUDA_PATH%"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
cmake --build build-local/glm5next-candidate-cuda --config Release -j 4
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
ctest --test-dir build-local/glm5next-candidate-cuda -C Release -V --no-tests=error
exit /b %errorlevel%
transport_build_script:
@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0.."
call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
set "CUDA_PATH=%CD%\build-local\cuda-13.0"
set "PATH=%CUDA_PATH%\bin;%CUDA_PATH%\bin\x64;%PATH%"
cmake -S backends/glm5next -B build-local/glm5next-transport -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DSTRATA_GLM_PROTOCOL_TESTS_ONLY=ON -DSTRATA_GLM_TRANSPORT_TESTS_CUDA=ON "-DCUDAToolkit_ROOT=%CUDA_PATH%"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
cmake --build build-local/glm5next-transport --config Release -j 4
exit /b %errorlevel%
transport_test_command: ctest --test-dir build-local/glm5next-transport -C Release -V --no-tests=error (CUDA bin and bin/x64 prepended to PATH)
python_test_command: python -m unittest tools.test_glm5next_profile tools.test_setup_glm5next tools.test_glm5next_build serve.test_glm5next serve.test_glm5next_info serve.test_glm5next_requests serve.test_glm5next_handlers serve.test_glm5next_http serve.test_glm5next_service
benchmark_final_command: python tools/benchmark_glm5next_mtp.py --profile strata-glm5next.json --reference docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json --second-reference build-local/glm-mtp-cache-reference-b.json --output <fresh path> --depths 0 --warmups 6 --repeats 6 --read-mode 0 --cache-compact <0 or 1> --decode-readers <1 or 2> --paging-counters
reference_B_recovery: The benchmark JSON embeds both references under references.A/references.B; write references.B to the local second-reference path to reproduce.
pipe_command: python tools/check_glm5next_engine.py --profile build-local/glm-compact-check-profile.json --reference docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json --output build-local/glm-compact-pipe.json (configuration embedded in PIPE report)
limits: No full F32 logits or HTTP rerun this stage; previous P5.3b remains separate.
No long context, Linux/HIP or full Qwen/DeepSeek regression.
Paging/disk counters are system-wide; process page faults are not split into hard/soft.
OS cache not cleared; sequential test processes and external load can affect comparisons.
Default runtime settings unchanged; only the backend patch identity was updated.
